acceptanceCriteria: Heartbeat median of 5 at 13k receipts is tens of milliseconds, load band recorded.
Intent tree is read once per write; fork and duplicate-request counterexamples remain refused.
body:
Parent: V1-0645. Observed: the writer fast route reads the intent tree twice (writer audit and inventory) and recomputes intent.TreeDigest in bindObservation; heartbeat costs about 0.4 s at 13k receipts. Target: tens of ms per heartbeat at 13k receipts.

Source: batch 4 lanes for GitHub #641-#647, 2026-10-06 (branches claude/v1-0645-audit-outside-lock, claude/scale-tasks-v1-0893, claude/scale-core-v1-0416, claude/gh644-live-upgrade). Darwin 25.6.0, go1.27.1. Versions: corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202; corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360).
